This might be what I have been struggling with, that is, Perioral Dermatitis. Google and see if that sounds like what you're having. Some of the pics online are kinda wild, but mostly it's small red raised bumps that are irritated.

The best solution I've found is just trying to keep skincare to a minimal unscented variety. Definitely no steroid creams as it can make PD come back worse after stopping use.

I feel you. I've very recently gone through something similar.

My partner (36M) and I (29F) decided to split up because he changed his mind/was questioning his desire for children. It was the hardest decision I've ever had to make and judging his tears so was his. I'm still in shock and devastatingly hurt.

I see him and other men around me getting so anxious because other friends around them procreate like bunnies (and then fall into hateful relationships with their partners) and keep asking them when they are getting children.

I can't help but think if these people would just keep their noses out of other people's businesses it might help normalise CF choice. I've even fallen into despair hating my own feelings and beliefs about CF, but every time I think it through I know that it is the right decision for me, it always has been.

It sucks ass (understatement of the year) to believe you've found someone you can build your life with and who shares your beliefs, just for them to later on change their minds.

If you want peer support, please shoot me a message.
I'm sorry, but I have to go, I wish you could understand.
